summary: SiteDocument represents documents associated with a particular site in the system. It is primarily a data entity linking SiteID and document ID for storing and retrieving site documents.
purpose: To link documents with specific sites, allowing document management, retrieval, and association to site records.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site associated with the document.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page and its code-behind that displays staff admin welcome information, last login details, and provides dropdown filters for sites and disciplines. It validates date inputs and allows filtering, refreshing, and paging of employment applications associated with sites and disciplines.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with a welcome interface showing last login, filtering options, and management of employment applications.

workflows.name: Employment Applications Filtering
steps: Select site and discipline filters.
Choose date range (start and end date).
Optionally enable show withdrawn applications.
Click Refresh to update grid view.
View filtered employment applications.

business_rules: RequiredFieldValidator for dates ensures date fields are not empty.
CustomValidator ensures start date is not after end date.

validations.rule: Start Date must be before or equal to End Date.

system_behavior: Panel shows last login details if available.
Dropdowns for sites and disciplines are populated based on agency and session.
RefreshData triggers data binding for employment applications grid.
GridView supports paging and displays employment applications.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, selection is cancelled.
Empty data templates show no data message.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing service codes linked to categories, names, descriptions, notes, and alternate language fields. Workflows exist for listing all service codes and for retrieving options by CourseID or TimetableID.
purpose: To categorize and describe various services with codes, and provide localized names and notes for alternate languages.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Listing
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session.
Fill ServiceCode data from database.
Apply localization if alt language mode.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Options by CourseID
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with session and CourseID.
Fill ServiceCode data from database.
Apply localization if alt language mode.

workflows.name: ServiceCode Options by TimetableID
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and TimetableID.
Fill ServiceCode data from database.
Apply localization if alt language mode.

business_rules: Use alternate language fields if session specifies alt language mode.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks actions taken on site profiles, including user actions, fields changed, agency/user information, and action dates. It formats the data for display, supports localization, and includes logic for special user scenarios.
purpose: To provide a historical record of site profile changes, including who made the change, what was changed, and when.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistorySearch
steps: Set parameters: SiteID, SessionAgencyID, Session.
Call database procedure.
Fill list from data reader.
Format for display.

business_rules: Support team users get special formatting in history.
Alternate language fields are used if session specifies.
system_behavior: Display tooltip details with formatted name and agency information.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents documents used for email popups, including file name, file path, and checked status. It includes workflows for searching and deleting popup documents with associated file operations.
purpose: To support the selection and management (including deletion) of documents used in email popup workflows.

workflows.name: EmailPopupDocument Search
steps: Call Search with DataInfo.
Split DataInfo by '|', parse each document.
Return EmailPopupDocument entries.

workflows.name: EmailPopupDocument Delete
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and document ID.
Delete file and containing folder on disk.
Update DataInfo string.

business_rules: If document is deleted, try to delete folder and file, ignore exceptions.
system_behavior: Documents are searched and parsed from delimited strings.
exceptions: File delete and folder delete exceptions are caught and ignored.

summary: ExpenseBatch represents batches of expenses processed by department. It tracks batch description, date, status, closed date, formatted batch number, and supports workflows for searching, adding, updating, and deleting expense batches.
purpose: To facilitate the management and tracking of departmental expense batches, including their statuses, dates, and descriptions.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch Search
steps: Call Search with session and departmentID.
Fill entries from database.
Return list.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch Add
steps: Call Add with session, departmentID, batch description, batch date.
Insert batch and return new ID.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch Update
steps: Call Update with session, ID, batch description, batch date, status code.
Update existing batch.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch Delete
steps: Call Delete with session and ID.
Remove batch from database.

business_rules: Use alternate language fields for status description if session specifies.
system_behavior: Supports searching, adding, updating, deleting batches.

summary: CostCentre and CostCentreRecord provide structured information on placement cost centers, including agencies, departments, programs, disciplines, sites, services, status, dates, counts, and hours. The main workflow aggregates placement-related financial and statistical data.
purpose: To extract, represent, and analyze placement cost center data for reporting and financial purposes.

workflows.name: CostCentre Data Retrieval
steps: Call GetCostCentre with session ID, date range, and optional filter parameters.
Aggregate and parse CostCentreRecord entries from database.
Return records.

summary: TimetableAssessments is a web interface and workflow for configuring assessment schedules for students. It supports adding, editing, deleting, and validating assessment entries. It provides dropdowns for assessor, subject, assessment type and template, and enforces rules about assessment dates, access, and viewing rights.
purpose: To manage assessment schedules for student placements, including details about assessors, subjects, assessment types, templates, and optional sections. It also validates rules for assessment intervals and permissions.

workflows.name: Assessment Entry Management
steps: Add/Edit/Delete assessment entries using grid and form view.
Populate dropdowns for assessor, subject, assessment type, and template.
Toggle optional sections and viewing permissions.
Validate interim/final rules and maximum constraints.
Display errors and notes as appropriate.

business_rules: If interim assessment exists without final, error is shown.
If instructors/supervisors overlap, error is shown.
Assessment open/close days must be numbers and within valid range.
validations: Custom validators for close/open days logic.
calculations: Days after placement start/end for scheduling.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable if actor has admin or coordinator role and not view only.
system_behavior: Grid and form views support editable and non-editable modes.
Panel and modal popup controls facilitate add/edit interactions.
JavaScript manages dynamic UI validation and toggling.
Entries bind to database and trigger validation checks.
dependencies: Dropdowns depend on codes and templates from database.
Validation results depend on backend checks.
exceptions: Display errors for interim without final, overlapping roles, and exceeded maximum.

summary: AdHocQuery provides methods to convert SQL query results into HTML tables for display. It is designed to help visualize arbitrary data from database readers.
purpose: To render SQL query results into formatted HTML tables for reporting or analysis purposes.

workflows.name: SQL Result Rendering
steps: Pass SqlDataReader to DataReaderToHTMLTable.
Generate header and data rows in HTML.
Return HTML string for display.

summary: StudentPrerequisites tracks and manages prerequisite information, immunizations, medical, confidentiality, mask fitting, and safety requirements for students. It contains validation and update logic for each requirement, formatted for reporting and system presentations.
purpose: To ensure student health, safety, and compliance with immunization, mask, confidentiality, and safety requirements for placements.

workflows.name: Prerequisite Management
steps: Search and retrieve prerequisites for student and staff.
Validate and update various health and safety requirements.
Update immunization, mask fit test, confidentiality, and safety fields.

business_rules: Validation rules check dates, years, and requirement completeness.
Immunity and mask fit/test dates must meet system constraints.
Mandatory fields enforced with error messages.
validations: Date fields must not exceed allowed ranges.
Year fields must be within MIN_YEAR and MaxYear.
Required fields for consent, dates, immunizations, mask fitting, etc.
system_behavior: Error messages added to session if validation fails.
